event_name: Wolf of the Willows Tap Takeover
date_text: Thu, Sep 10th • 12:00 PM AEST - Sun, Sep 13th • 10:00 PM AEST
description: Anyone who’s been drinking at Sweeney’s for a while will know that Wolf of the Willows and our taps go way back. Back when XPA was the flagship, we were pouring Wolf — and we’ve been fans ever since. These days, the Melbourne brewery has built a cracking core range alongside some seriously good specialty releases, so we thought it was about time we handed them the taps. Kicking off from midday Thursday, we’ll be pouring 12 Wolf beers and ciders, from the classics through to some more unusual stuff — including a couple of German-inspired releases arriving just in time for Oktoberfest, plus The Snowball Effect Stout and a very special Lark Barrel Aged Imperial JSP IV. Tap List:- - XPA - IPA - Wolf PUP - Crisp Lager - Ginger Beer - Hazy Apple Cider - Pacific Sour - Helles Lager - Marzen - Festbier - The Snowball Effect - Stout - Lark Barrel Aged Imp. JSP IV
